title: Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture
statement: Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture · 1995. Every graph of minimum degree at least three contains a cycle whose length is a power of two.

counterexample.description: A counterexample is a minimum-degree-three graph with no cycles of lengths 4, 8, 16, and so on. Enumerating all simple cycles verifies it.
